properties.name: Raskolnikov
properties.description: A young former student living in extreme poverty in a tiny garret. Possessed by a certain 'plan', he is the protagonist burdened with sharp intellect and deep self-contradiction.

properties.name: Razumikhin
properties.description: Raskolnikov's old university friend. A student with a cheerful and honest character who worries about his friend and tries to help him.

properties.name: Sonya
properties.description: Marmeladov's daughter. A young woman compelled to sell herself to support her family. She possesses a deep and fervent faith.

properties.name: Porfiry
properties.description: An examining magistrate. With keen insight, he gradually corners Raskolnikov.

properties.name: Dunya
properties.description: Raskolnikov's sister. A strong-willed woman who resolved to become engaged to Luzhin in a self-sacrificing act for the sake of her family.

properties.name: Svidrigailov
properties.description: Dunya's former employer. A wealthy landowner with a mysterious past who is obsessed with Dunya.

properties.name: Katerina
properties.description: Marmeladov's wife. Suffering from tuberculosis, she struggles desperately to raise her children. Proud and worn down by their wretched circumstances.

properties.name: Lizaveta
properties.description: The half-sister of Alyona, the old moneylender. Kind and gentle by nature. She happens to arrive at the scene of the crime by chance.

properties.name: Marmeladov
properties.description: A retired civil servant. An alcoholic who recounts in a tavern how his daughter Sonya came to become a prostitute. A man consumed by self-loathing and remorse.

properties.name: Alyona
properties.description: An old woman who runs a pawnshop. Portrayed as a greedy figure who charges Raskolnikov exploitative interest rates.

properties.name: Nastasya
properties.description: The servant at Raskolnikov's lodging house. Easygoing in nature, she looks after the ailing Raskolnikov.

properties.name: Pulkheria Raskolnikova
properties.description: Raskolnikov's mother. She loves her son deeply and informs him by letter of his sister Dunya's engagement.

properties.name: Pyotr Petrovich Luzhin
properties.description: Dunya's fiancé. A calculating and self-centered middle-aged lawyer whom Raskolnikov despises.

properties.name: Vasily Ivanovich Vakhrushev
properties.description: A merchant. An old acquaintance of Raskolnikov's mother who acts as an intermediary for the money she sends.

properties.name: Marfa Petrovna
properties.description: Svidrigailov's wife. She falsely accused Dunya but later vindicated her reputation.

properties.name: Koch
properties.description: A visitor who comes to call at the old woman's apartment. He appears in the tense moments immediately after the crime, indirectly putting pressure on Raskolnikov.

properties.name: Mitka
properties.description: A house painter. On the day of the murder, he is doing painting work in the old woman's building, which affords Raskolnikov an opportunity to hide.

properties.name: Zosimov
properties.description: A doctor. An acquaintance of Razumikhin who examines and treats the ailing Raskolnikov. He monitors Raskolnikov's mental state with a calm, observant eye.

properties.name: Lebezyatnikov
properties.description: Luzhin's roommate. A young civil servant who professes progressive ideas. He witnesses Luzhin attempting to frame Sonya and testifies to her innocence.

properties.name: Zamyotov
properties.description: A police clerk. Raskolnikov contacts him to probe for information about the case. He is led astray by Raskolnikov's games during their conversation in a tavern.
